# Templates

Starting points for the documents this repository needs again and again.
Copy the file, fill it in, and delete the instructions in the HTML comments.

| Template | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [release-notes.md](release-notes.md) | The entry for a new version in `CHANGELOG.md`, and the text of the release |
| [doc-page.md](doc-page.md) | A new page under `docs/` |
| [known-issue.md](known-issue.md) | A problem that is confirmed but not fixed yet |
| [release-checklist.md](release-checklist.md) | The steps for publishing a version |

Issue forms and the pull request template are in `.github/`.
